mutable struct AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer

    max_vocab_size::Int
    d_model::Int
    grid_size::Int
    degree::Int
    vocab::Dict{String, Int}
    merges::Dict{Tuple{String, String}, String}
    
    function AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer(; base_vocab_size::Int=32768, max_vocab_size::Int=65536, d_model::Int=18432, grid_size::Int=8, degree::Int=4)

            throw(ArgumentError("grid_size must be positive"))

            throw(ArgumentError("degree must satisfy 0 <= degree < grid_size"))
        end

            throw(ArgumentError("d_model must be positive and reasonable"))
        end
        if base_vocab_size <= 0 || max_vocab_size < base_vocab_size
            throw(ArgumentError("vocabulary sizes must satisfy 0 < base_vocab_size <= max_vocab_size"))
        end

        vocab["UNK"] = 0
        vocab["PAD"] = 1
        vocab["BOS"] = 2
        vocab["EOS"] = 3

            vocab[string(Char(i))] = length(vocab)
        end

    end

function _lorenz_embedding(token_id::Float64, token_position::Float64, embedding_dim::Int)::Vector{Float64}

    rho_param = 28.0
    beta_param = 8.0 / 3.0
    time_step = 0.01
    
    x_state = token_id * 0.1
    y_state = token_position * 2.0
    z_state = token_id * 0.05
    
    embedding_vector = Vector{Float64}(undef, embedding_dim)
    
    @inbounds for dimension_index in 1:embedding_dim
        x_derivative = sigma_param * (y_state - x_state)
        y_derivative = x_state * (rho_param - z_state) - y_state
        z_derivative = x_state * y_state - beta_param * z_state
        
        x_state += x_derivative * time_step
        y_state += y_derivative * time_step
        z_state += z_derivative * time_step
        
        embedding_vector[dimension_index] = 0.1 * sin(x_state) + 0.1 * cos(y_state) + 0.1 * sin(z_state)
    end
    
    return embedding_vector
end

function _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point::Float64, knot_vector::Vector{Float64}, basis_index::Int, basis_degree::Int)::Float64
    knot_length = length(knot_vector)
    
    if basis_index < 1 || basis_index > knot_length || basis_degree < 0
        return 0.0
    end
    
    if basis_index + basis_degree >= knot_length
        return 0.0
    end
    
    if basis_degree == 0
        lower_knot = knot_vector[basis_index]
        upper_knot = knot_vector[basis_index + 1]

        at_endpoint = (abs(evaluation_point - 1.0) < EPSILON_THRESHOLD && abs(upper_knot - 1.0) < EPSILON_THRESHOLD)

    end
    
    coefficient_lower = knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree] - knot_vector[basis_index]
    first_term = 0.0
    
    if abs(coefficient_lower) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        recursive_basis_lower = _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point, knot_vector, basis_index, basis_degree - 1)
        if abs(recursive_basis_lower) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
            first_term = ((evaluation_point - knot_vector[basis_index]) / coefficient_lower) * recursive_basis_lower
        end
    end
    
    coefficient_upper = knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree + 1] - knot_vector[basis_index + 1]
    second_term = 0.0
    
    if abs(coefficient_upper) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        recursive_basis_upper = _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point, knot_vector, basis_index + 1, basis_degree - 1)
        if abs(recursive_basis_upper) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
            second_term = ((knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree + 1] - evaluation_point) / coefficient_upper) * recursive_basis_upper
        end
    end
    
    return first_term + second_term

function _make_knots(grid_dimension::Int, polynomial_degree::Int)::Vector{Float64}
    interior_count = grid_dimension - polynomial_degree + 1
    
    if interior_count <= 0
        return vcat(zeros(Float64, polynomial_degree), [0.0, 1.0], ones(Float64, polynomial_degree))
    end
    
    interior_knots = collect(range(0.0, 1.0; length=interior_count))
    knot_sequence = vcat(

        interior_knots,
        ones(Float64, polynomial_degree)
    )

    function AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer(; base_vocab_size::Int=32768, max_vocab_size::Int=65536, d_model::Int=18432, grid_size::Int=8, degree::Int=4)
        if grid_size <= 0 || degree < 0 || degree >= grid_size
            throw(ArgumentError("Invalid spline parameters: grid_size must be > 0 and degree must satisfy 0 <= degree < grid_size"))
        end
        vocab = Dict{String, Int}("UNK" => 0, "PAD" => 1, "BOS" => 2, "EOS" => 3)
        for i in 32:126
            vocab[string(Char(i))] = length(vocab)
        end
        new(base_vocab_size, max_vocab_size, d_model, grid_size, degree, vocab, Dict{Tuple{String, String}, String}())
    end
end

function _lorenz_embedding!(dest::Vector{Float64}, id::Float64, index::Float64, d_model::Int)
    sigma = 10.0
    rho = 28.0
    beta = 8.0 / 3.0
    dt = 0.01
    x = id * 0.1
    y = index * 2.0
    z = id * 0.05
    @inbounds for j in 1:d_model
        dx = sigma * (y - x)
        dy = x * (rho - z) - y
        dz = x * y - beta * z
        x += dx * dt
        y += dy * dt
        z += dz * dt
        dest[j] = 0.1 * sin(x) + 0.1 * cos(y) + 0.1 * sin(z)
    end
    return nothing
end

function _b_spline_basis(x::Float64, knots::Vector{Float64}, i::Int, k::Int)
    if k == 0
        return ((knots[i] <= x < knots[i+1]) || (x == 1.0 && knots[i+1] == 1.0)) ? 1.0 : 0.0
    end
    term1_denom = knots[i + k] - knots[i]
    term1 = term1_denom == 0.0 ? 0.0 : (x - knots[i]) / term1_denom * _b_spline_basis(x, knots, i, k - 1)
    term2_denom = knots[i + k + 1] - knots[i + 1]
    term2 = term2_denom == 0.0 ? 0.0 : (knots[i + k + 1] - x) / term2_denom * _b_spline_basis(x, knots, i + 1, k - 1)
    return term1 + term2
end

function _make_knots(grid_size::Int, degree::Int)
    return vcat(zeros(Float64, degree), collect(range(0.0, 1.0; length=grid_size - degree + 1)), ones(Float64, degree))
end

function _kan_spline_eval(x::Float64, coeffs::Vector{Float64}, knots::Vector{Float64}, grid_size::Int, degree::Int)
    val = 0.0
    @inbounds for i in 1:grid_size
        val += coeffs[i] * _b_spline_basis(x, knots, i, degree)
    end
    return val
end

function encode(tokenizer::AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, text::String, birth_chart::Vector{Float64})
    normalized_text = lowercase(replace(text, r"\s+" => " "))
    graphemes_vec = collect(Unicode.graphemes(normalized_text))
    ids = Vector{Int}(undef, length(graphemes_vec))
    @inbounds for i in 1:length(graphemes_vec)
        ids[i] = get(tokenizer.vocab, graphemes_vec[i], 0)
    end
    embeddings = Matrix{Float64}(undef, length(ids), tokenizer.d_model)
    spline_coeffs = rand(Float64, tokenizer.grid_size)
    knots = _make_knots(tokenizer.grid_size, tokenizer.degree)
    glen = length(ids)
    bc_len = length(birth_chart)
    lorenz_vec = Vector{Float64}(undef, tokenizer.d_model)
    @inbounds for i in 1:length(ids)
        tid = ids[i]
        _lorenz_embedding!(lorenz_vec, float(tid), float(i), tokenizer.d_model)
        w1 = sin(tid * 0.1) * 0.5 + 0.5
        w2 = 1.0 - w1
        deg = (CELESTIAL_CHART_1[mod1(tid, length(CELESTIAL_CHART_1))] * w1) + (CELESTIAL_CHART_2[mod1(i, length(CELESTIAL_CHART_2))] * w2)
        phase_shift = sin(i * 0.1 + deg2rad(deg))
        @inbounds @simd for j in 1:tokenizer.d_model
            lorenz_vec[j] += phase_shift
        end
        spline_x = glen > 1 ? (i - 1) / (glen - 1) : 0.0
        spline_val = _kan_spline_eval(spline_x, spline_coeffs, knots, tokenizer.grid_size, tokenizer.degree)
        orb_mod = bc_len == 0 ? 0.0 : SYNASTRY_ORBS[mod1(i, length(SYNASTRY_ORBS))] * 0.01 * birth_chart[mod1(i, bc_len)]
        base_add = spline_val + orb_mod
        @inbounds @simd for j in 1:tokenizer.d_model
            embeddings[i, j] = lorenz_vec[j] + base_add
        end
    end
    if length(tokenizer.vocab) < tokenizer.max_vocab_size
        new_token = "JAIDE"
        if !haskey(tokenizer.vocab, new_token)
            tokenizer.vocab[new_token] = length(tokenizer.vocab)
        end
    end
    return ids, embeddings
end

function decode(tokenizer::AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, ids::Vector{Int})
    id_to_char = Dict(v => k for (k, v) in tokenizer.vocab)
    buf = IOBuffer()
    @inbounds for i in 1:length(ids)
        write(buf, get(id_to_char, ids[i], "UNK"))
    end
    return String(take!(buf))
end

Az E verzió `@simd` direktívákkal próbál vektorizációt erősíteni, azonban ez nem garantál javulást minden esetben.  A D verzió helyesen nem tartalmaz szükségtelen `@simd` megjegyzéseket, hanem az LLVM compiler automatikus optimalizálására hagyatkozik, amely általában elegendő.[2][1]
